content.short: DeepBook is Sui's native central limit order book (CLOB) liquidity layer, providing the backbone for Sui's DeFi.
content.description: DeepBook is a decentralized, first-party liquidity layer built directly into the Sui blockchain, serving as a foundational infrastructure for the network's DeFi ecosystem. It utilizes a central limit order book (CLOB) model to provide deep, shared liquidity that any protocol on Sui can tap into, reducing fragmentation and improving trade execution for all users. The protocol is governed and incentivized by the DEEP token, which aligns the interests of liquidity providers, developers, and the community. By providing a highly performant and transparent venue for asset exchange, DeepBook empowers builders to create sophisticated financial products that rival centralized alternatives in speed and cost.
